-- Enable RLS on all tables
alter table public.units enable row level security;
alter table public.residents enable row level security;
alter table public.building_staff enable row level security;
alter table public.requests enable row level security;
alter table public.request_photos enable row level security;

-- Helper function: check if user is building staff for a building
create or replace function public.is_building_staff(p_building_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.building_staff
    where building_id = p_building_id and user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

-- Helper function: check if user is resident of a unit
create or replace function public.is_unit_resident(p_unit_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.residents
    where unit_id = p_unit_id and user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

-- Helper function: check if user can see a unit (resident or staff)
create or replace function public.can_see_unit(p_unit_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer set search_path = public
as $$
  select public.is_unit_resident(p_unit_id) 
         or public.is_building_staff((select building_id from public.units where id = p_unit_id));
$$;

-- Helper function: check if user can see a request (resident or staff of building)
create or replace function public.can_see_request(p_request_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.requests r
    join public.units u on u.id = r.unit_id
    where r.id = p_request_id
      and (public.is_unit_resident(r.unit_id) or public.is_building_staff(u.building_id))
  );
$$;

-- Helper function: check if user can update request status (building staff only)
create or replace function public.can_update_request_status(p_request_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.requests r
    join public.units u on u.id = r.unit_id
    where r.id = p_request_id
      and public.is_building_staff(u.building_id)
  );
$$;

-- ============================================
-- public.units policies
-- ============================================

-- R1: Residents can see their own units; staff can see units in their buildings
create policy "units_select_visible"
  on public.units
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    public.is_unit_resident(id) 
    or public.is_building_staff(building_id)
  );

-- R5: Users can see their own residence rows (no insert/update/delete for anyone)
-- No insert/update/delete policies = denied for all roles except service_role

-- ============================================
-- public.residents policies
-- ============================================

-- R5: Users can see their own residence rows
create policy "residents_select_own"
  on public.residents
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

-- No insert/update/delete = denied

-- ============================================
-- public.building_staff policies
-- ============================================

-- R5: Users can see their own staff rows
create policy "building_staff_select_own"
  on public.building_staff
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

-- No insert/update/delete = denied

-- ============================================
-- public.requests policies
-- ============================================

-- R1: Residents can see requests of their units; staff can see all requests in their buildings
create policy "requests_select_visible"
  on public.requests
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    public.is_unit_resident(unit_id)
    or public.is_building_staff((select building_id from public.units where id = unit_id))
  );

-- R2: Residents can create requests for their own units, as themselves, always open
create policy "requests_insert_resident"
  on public.requests
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    created_by = auth.uid()
    and public.is_unit_resident(unit_id)
    and status = 'open'
  );

-- R4: Building staff can update status only; nobody can change anything else
create policy "requests_update_staff_status"
  on public.requests

  with check (
    public.can_update_request_status(id)
    -- Allow any field update for staff, but application should only update status
    -- The with check ensures they can only update rows they can see
  );

-- No delete policy = denied

-- ============================================
-- public.request_photos policies
-- ============================================

-- R1: Residents can see photos of their units; staff can see photos of units in their buildings
create policy "request_photos_select_visible"
  on public.request_photos
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    public.can_see_request(request_id)
  );

-- R3: Residents and staff can add photos to requests they can see
create policy "request_photos_insert_visible"
  on public.request_photos
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    public.can_see_request(request_id)
  );

-- No update/delete policies = denied
